Let's include Day 1 (\"e22\", False)!\nlogs[1].append((\"e22\", False))\n\ncounts = {e: [0, 0] for e in sales} # [non_ah, ah]\nfor d, entries in logs.items():\n    for e, ah in entries:\n        counts[e][1 if ah else 0] += 1\n\n# Interviews: [non_evasive, evasive]\ninterviews = {\n    \"e02\": [1, 0], # D4 coop\n    \"e07\": [2, 1], # D3 coop, D6 evas, D8 coop\n    \"e08\": [5, 2], # D4 coop, D8 coop, D9 coop/evas/evas, D10 coop/coop\n    \"e16\": [5, 0], # D2 coop, D4 coop, D5 coop, D6 coop, D9 coop\n    \"e22\": [5, 3], # D3 coop, D4 evas, D5 evas, D6 evas, D7 coop/coop/coop, D8 coop, D9 coop -> wait: D3(1)+D4(1)+D5(1)+D6(1)+D7(3)+D8(1)+D9(1) = 9 total: 6 non-evas, 3 evas!\n    \"e24\": [1, 0], # D4 coop\n    \"e33\": [6, 3], # D2 coop, D5 coop, D6 coop/evas, D7 evas/coop/coop, D8 coop, D9 evas -> 9 total: 6 non-evas, 3 evas!\n    \"e36\": [2, 1], # D5 evas, D6 coop, D9 coop\n    \"e39\": [3, 1], # D3 coop, D10 evas/coop/coop\n}\ninterviews[\"e22\"] = [6, 3]\n\nimport math\n\n# Rates per day (T = 10 days):\n# Mole: non_ah rate = 0.7, ah rate = 0.3 (NO fake framing accesses go to mole!)\n# Innocent (non-decoy): non_ah rate = 0.9, ah rate = 0.1 + fake_rate\n# Default fake_rate = 2.0 * 0.5 / 38 = 1.0 / 38 = 0.026316 (or if DSL adds +1 random colleague: +1/39 = 0.05196)\nfor extra_frame in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n    lam_ah_inn = 0.1 + 1.0/38.0 + extra_frame\n    lam_nah_inn = 0.9\n    lam_ah_mole = 0.3\n    lam_nah_mole = 0.7\n    T = 10.0\n    \n    weights = {}\n    for e in sales:\n        nah, ah = counts[e]\n        nevas, evas = interviews[e]\n        # Log likelihood ratio mole vs innocent:\n        llr = (\n            ah * math.log(lam_ah_mole / lam_ah_inn)\n            - T * (lam_ah_mole - lam_ah_inn)\n            + nah * math.log(lam_nah_mole / lam_nah_inn)\n            - T * (lam_nah_mole - lam_nah_inn)\n            + evas * math.log(0.24 / 0.20)\n            + nevas * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n        )\n        weights[e] = math.exp(llr)\n    tot = sum(weights.values())\n    print(f\"=== Extra framing = {extra_frame:.4f} (innocent AH rate = {lam_ah_inn:.4f}/day) ===\")\n    for e in sorted(sales, key=lambda x: -weights[x]):\n        print(f\"  {e}: nonAH={counts[e][0]:2d}, AH={counts[e][1]:2d} | int={interviews[e][1]}/{sum(interviews[e])} evas | LLR={math.log(weights[e]):+.2f} | P={weights[e]/tot:.4f}\")\nEOF","time":{"start":1794698703432,"end":1794698703533}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc60f22e001Jw5LXSbgbK34UC","sessionID":"ses_e23b031e8ffedAJkV09ahWtbSj","messageID":"msg_1dc605769001eyffax5o8UK8Uj"}}
